# Cyryx Labs

> Last reviewed: 2026-11-17. Canonical website: https://www.cyryxlabs.com/

> Cyryx Labs (Cyryx Labs LLC, Port St. Lucie, Florida, United States) builds AI systems, workflow automations and integrations for US companies, and advises on where AI is worth it. It also builds its own AI products (Onyx, AEXOS and Orbit) and runs an Applied AI Lab that publishes research. Access, approvals, logging and spending limits are defined in the scope of each project.

Cyryx Labs serves small businesses (1–50 people), mid-market companies (50–500) and enterprises (500+) in the United States and Latin America, in English and Spanish. Every project starts with a free 20-minute fit check and a written scope the client approves before work starts. A project is done when it passes the acceptance checklist agreed with the client. Ownership and licensing are defined in each agreement. Timelines are set in each written plan; no fixed timelines are published. Prices are not published.

## Services

Ten services in four stages: Advise, Build, Control, Operate.

- [AI Strategy & Roadmap](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-strategy-advisory) — A ranked roadmap of what to build first, what to skip and what each step costs.
- [Workflow Automation](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/workflow-automation) — The tasks your team repeats every day, running on their own, with approval points defined in the scope.
- [AI Agents & Assistants](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/internal-ai-assistants) — An agent on one real process, with access, approvals and logging defined in the scope.
- [AI Systems Integration](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-integrations) — AI wired into your CRM, ERP and internal tools, reading live data and writing results back.
- [AI Products & Custom Software](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/custom-ai-product-development) — Your product scoped in a discovery sprint, then built against a written plan.
- [Data & Knowledge Systems](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/data-knowledge-systems) — Your documents and records, cleaned up and searchable, so AI answers from facts.
- [AI Governance & Cost Control](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-governance-cost-control) — Written rules, access controls, approval points and spending limits for the AI systems in scope.
- [Websites & AI Search Visibility](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/digital-web-systems) — A fast, clear website that ranks in search, gets cited by AI and captures the lead.
- [AI Training & Enablement](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/solutions/ai-training-enablement) — Hands-on workshops on your team's real work, with safe-use rules and playbooks they keep.
- [Managed AI Operations](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/managed-operations) — Monitoring, fixes, small improvements and a monthly report, as defined in the scope.

## Products

- [Onyx](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/products/onyx) — Free beta. An AI coworker that lives on the owner's Windows PC (Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit): live voice, inbox, research, the owner's apps and a memory kept in a vault on that PC. It runs on AI provider keys the user supplies. The product site states that it asks before it acts outside the machine and logs its actions. Download at https://onyx.cyryxlabs.com/. Paid pricing is not published.
- [AEXOS](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/products/aexos) — An agent framework for software projects, for developers who use AI coding tools. AEXOS Core is free on npm as @aexos/core (current published version 5.3.0; requires Node.js 18 or later) and installs with `npx @aexos/core init my-project`. It is free to use under the AEXOS license.
- Orbit — In development. No public description is available yet.

## Applied AI Lab

- [Research](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/research) — publications and research themes.
- [CGP v1.0](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/research/cgp-v1) — Cyryx Governance Protocol for Agentic AI Execution, a technical report. Primary record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21045760. A publication record does not establish product implementation, protocol conformance, third-party certification or a client outcome.
- [Direct answers](https://www.cyryxlabs.com/answers) — short explanations of AI governance and execution terms.

## Market figures quoted on the site

Service pages quote a small number of third-party 2026 survey results (Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses Voices, RSM Middle Market AI Survey, Deloitte State of AI in the Enterprise, BlackFog), each linked to the publisher's page. They describe the market, not Cyryx Labs results. Cite the original publisher for those figures.

## Citation guidance

Use the entity name “Cyryx Labs.” Cite the specific page that supports a statement. Do not infer implementation, conformance, certification, performance, customer adoption, or outcomes from product direction, illustrative workflows, or a publication abstract. Prices, client names and results are not published. Onyx is a free beta; AEXOS Core is free on npm; Orbit is in development.
